import json, re
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('.')
res = json.loads((root/'resolution.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
plan = json.loads((root/'plan.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
peers = json.loads((root/'environment/peers.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
orders = json.loads((root/'environment/orders.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
text = (root/'environment/jielong.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8')

assert not (root/'resolution.json').read_bytes().startswith(b'\\xef\\xbb\\xbf')
assert not (root/'plan.json').read_bytes().startswith(b'\\xef\\xbb\\xbf')
assert len(res) == 13 and [x['seq'] for x in res] == list(range(1, 14))
assert all(list(x) == ['seq','raw','sid','status','slots','note'] for x in res)
assert all(x['status'] in {'matched','unmatched','conflict'} for x in res)
assert all(x['slots'] in ([], ['19:00'], ['20:20'], ['19:00','20:20']) for x in res)
assert all(x['sid'] is None for x in res if x['status'] "'!= '"'matched')
assert all(x['sid'] is not None for x in res if x['status'] == 'matched')

# Recover each numbered source line and verify raw stripping.
source = {}
for line in text.splitlines():
    m = re.match(r'"'^('"\\d+)[.、)）]\\s*(.*)"'$'"', line)
    if m:
        seq, raw = int(m.group(1)), m.group(2)
        assert seq not in source
        source[seq] = (line, raw)
for x in res:
    assert source[x['seq']][1] == x['raw'], (x['seq'], source[x['seq']][1], x['raw'])

by_seq = {x['seq']: x for x in res}
assert by_seq[2]['slots'] == ['20:20'] and '21:00' in by_seq[2]['note']
assert by_seq[3]['sid'] == peers['self_id'] and by_seq[3]['slots'] == [] and by_seq[3]['note']
assert by_seq[8]['status'] == 'unmatched' and by_seq[8]['sid'] is None and by_seq[8]['note']
assert by_seq[11]['status'] == 'conflict' and by_seq[11]['sid'] is None
assert all(sid in by_seq[11]['note'] for sid in ['2025000142','2025000157'])
assert by_seq[13]['status'] == 'unmatched' and by_seq[13]['note']

assert len(plan) == len(orders['orders'])
assert all(list(x) == ['orderNo','add','skip','reject','reason'] for x in plan)
assert [x['orderNo'] for x in plan] == [x['orderNo'] for x in orders['orders']]
assert all(x['reason'] for x in plan)

# Exact-key/capacity checks and reject-region consistency.
cap = orders['capacity_per_order']
for po, oo in zip(plan, orders['orders']):
    assert len(oo['peers']) + len(po['add']) <= cap if oo['blockType'] == 2 else not po['add']
    assert not set(po['add']) & set(oo['peers'])
    assert not set(po['add']) & set(po['skip'])
    assert not set(po['add']) & set(po['reject'])
assert any(p['reject'] for p in plan)

counts = {k: sum(1 for x in res if x['status']==k) for k in ('matched','unmatched','conflict')}
totals = {k: sum(len(p[k]) for p in plan) for k in ('add','skip','reject')}
print('validation: OK')
print('resolution:', counts)
print('plan totals:', totals)
print('adds/skips/rejects:')
for p in plan:
    print(p['orderNo'], len(p['add']), len(p['skip']), len(p['reject']))
PY"
